name: Citizenship for Persons of Albanian Origin (Extended Ancestry Route)

qualifying_event.description: A foreign citizen who establishes a direct lineal kinship up to the third degree with an ancestor of Albanian origin may apply for Albanian citizenship, without needing to meet the standard naturalization residence requirement.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documentation establishing the kinship chain to the qualifying Albanian-origin ancestor; language and history assessment.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires establishing a direct lineal kinship up to the third degree with an ancestor of Albanian origin, per Article 8(1)(dh)/(ë).
requirements.fix_path: Document the kinship chain to a qualifying Albanian-origin ancestor.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires demonstrated knowledge of the Albanian language and basic history, same as the standard naturalization route.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the Albanian language and history assessment.

evidence_required.document: Documentation establishing the kinship chain to the Albanian-origin ancestor (birth/marriage certificates spanning generations)
Albanian language and history test results

sources.title: Republic of Albania -- Law No. 113/2020 on Citizenship (official English translation), Article 8(1)(dh) and (ë): citizenship for foreign citizens establishing lineal kinship up to the third degree with an ancestor of Albanian origin

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). STATUS: DRAFT -- the tier-1 primary law confirms this route EXISTS and its kinship-degree and language/history conditions, but the extraction pass could not confirm whether a residence requirement is waived entirely for this route or merely reduced, nor whether it exempts the language/history test that Article 8(1)'s chapeau otherwise seems to attach to all of subsection (1)'s pathways -- this file conservatively includes the language/history requirement rather than assume it is waived. This is functionally distinct from al_citizenship_by_descent.json: that file is AUTOMATIC for a child of a CURRENTLY-citizen parent (Article 5); this route is an ASSESSED APPLICATION for someone whose Albanian ancestor may be several generations back and who may hold no other tie to a living Albanian citizen. This is the kind of provision commonly marketed as 'Albanian citizenship by descent for diaspora' by immigration consultancies -- flagged as draft specifically because the precise mechanics (residence waiver scope, required generation-spanning documentation standard) were not confirmed at tier-1 precision and deserve a follow-up pass before publishing.
